name: open-food-facts-mcp
title: Open Food Facts MCP
description: Four read-only MCP tools for product lookups, text search, taxonomy suggestions and nutrition comparisons.

output.title: Open Food Facts MCP responses
output.description: Product results are returned directly to the connected MCP client through the private task Standby endpoint. This Actor does not persist product results in a dataset or key-value store. A regular batch run performs initialization and tool discovery only.
